journey.name: HomeToDetailNavigationJourney
journey.description: Verifies navigation from the home screen image grid to the image detail screen for a user who logs in via the UI using a real Firebase test account. Actions conceptually map to reusable Kotlin step definitions.

actions.action:
Journey: HomeToDetailNavigationWithRealLogin Name: Home to Detail Screen Navigation (Real Firebase Login) Description: Verifies UI login with a real test account, then navigation from the home screen image grid to the image detail screen, including verification of specific image content. Author: VSay Tags: navigation, real-auth, p1
# NO PRECONDITION about being already logged in. # The app will start, and we will perform a UI login.
# Main Journey Steps: Given I am on the login screen # This step assumes the app starts on or can be navigated to the login screen.
When I call 'SharedJourneySteps.attemptUILogin' with email 'toto@yopmail.com' and pass 'Asdf12345' # IMPORTANT: Replace with actual credentials for a VALID test account in your Firebase project.
Then I should be on the home screen # This step should verify that login was successful and the home screen is displayed.# e.g., Then I call 'SharedJourneySteps.verifyUserIsOnHomeScreen'.
When I call 'SharedJourneySteps.selectFirstImageInGrid'. # This step simulates the user tapping on the first available image in the grid. # For this test, we assume the first image consistently has an identifiable # characteristic, e.g., a title like "Static Test Image Title 1".
Then I call 'SharedJourneySteps.verifyDetailScreenIsVisible' with expectedImageIdentifier 'Static Test Image Title 1'. # PARAMETERIZED VERIFICATION: We now pass an expected identifier. # Replace 'Static Test Image Title 1' with an actual identifier # you expect for the first image in your test dataset when displayed on the detail screen.
# Conceptual Post-condition / Cleanup (Optional but good practice for test isolation): # If SharedJourneySteps.signOutUserViaUI exists and works: # Postcondition: Call 'SharedJourneySteps.signOutUserViaUI'
